data.name: Faateh
data.gender_notes: Faateh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Fath’ meaning conquest, victory, and triumph. The name Faateh is deeply rooted in Islamic history, symbolizing the spiritual victory one experiences when submitting to Allah. The name Faateh carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faateh usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, symbolizing one's ongoing journey towards Allah and the ultimate victory of faith.
data.etymology: Faateh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faateh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
